script: The skill you choose matters more than anything else in this course. The right skill is one that you can learn with free resources, that you can practise in short blocks, and that people will pay for. Let us look at skills that suit beginners. A social media helper creates and schedules simple posts for small businesses, using Canva and WhatsApp on a phone. Canva graphic design means flyers, posters, Instagram posts and menus. Content writing means product descriptions, blog posts and short captions. Virtual assistance means email, calendars, scheduling and simple research. Data entry and typing are often the fastest route to a first job, usually in two to six weeks. Video editing with CapCut on a phone suits people who enjoy short reels and captions. Transcription suits careful listeners who type accurately. Online tutoring suits teachers of school subjects or languages. Bookkeeping basics suit organised women who enjoy numbers.
glossary: Canva, WhatsApp Business, Gmail, Google Drive, Google Docs, Google Sheets, Upwork, Fiverr, LinkedIn, CapCut, Payoneer, OTP, PIN, freelance, Facebook, Instagram
